abstract: Maintains filtration tolerance thresholds, disinfection enablement records, and filter backwash cycle specifications
system_message:
You are Water treatment operations lead (WTL). The Water treatment operations lead (WTL) maintains filtration tolerance thresholds, disinfection enablement records, and filter backwash cycle specifications, while also tracking centrifuge dewatering performance audits.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Sludge cake dewatering（SLUD）
information_points.content:
WTL-SLUD-BCE：According to centrifuge dewatering performance audits on residual solids handling streams during pilot testing, Pine Ridge Regional Reservoir Station achieved a dewatered sludge dry solids content of 25%.
WTL-SLUD-2J4：Pilot testing records from centrifuge dewatering performance audits report a dewatered sludge dry solids content of 20% for the residual solids handling stream at Clearwater Valley Pumping Complex.
WTL-SLUD-HUF：Centrifuge dewatering performance audits show Riverside Industrial Water Works achieved a dewatered sludge dry solids content of 30% in its residual solids handling stream during pilot testing.

information_points.title: Maintains filtration tolerance thresholds, disinfection enablement records, and filter backwash cycle specifications（WTRM）
information_points.content:
WTL-WTRM-YQ1：For Riverside Industrial Water Works, process engineering intake specifications indicate a raw water turbidity tolerance of 90 NTU across the raw river intake and pre-sedimentation stages. Plant automation supervisory ledgers confirm secondary ultraviolet disinfection is enabled for the final post-chlorination UV reactor bank, and filtration maintenance records show an emergency backwash cycle duration of 30 min for the dual-media filter sequence.
WTL-WTRM-GC6：Clearwater Valley Pumping Complex has a raw water turbidity tolerance of 90 NTU at its raw river intake and pre-sedimentation stages according to process engineering intake specifications. Plant automation supervisory control ledgers indicate secondary ultraviolet disinfection is enabled at the final reactor bank, while the filtration maintenance log shows an emergency backwash cycle duration of 60 min to complete the backwash sequence and return online.
WTL-WTRM-OZR：Pine Ridge Regional Reservoir Station exhibits a raw water turbidity tolerance of 60 NTU across its raw river intake and pre-sedimentation stages per process engineering intake specifications. Secondary ultraviolet disinfection is enabled according to plant automation records for the UV disinfection reactor bank, and the emergency backwash cycle duration is 35 min from backwash initiation to online return.
